publication_gate: Passed: all five streams complete; native replay, hosted aggregate replay, and hosted raw-response replay audits agree with exact source hashes.
title: JevBench public subset: previously released Open-Jev baselines
scope: 231 public JevBench tasks only: 72 original, 48 easy, 111 hard. The private and judge tiers are unavailable; this is not the full 534-task benchmark and no full-benchmark composite is computed. ZefanCai Open-Jev uses Qwen LoRA weights and a decision head; it is a different system from the Kotoba and Codiv projects also called OpenJev.

protocol.rounding_policy: Vectors outside strict tolerance but inside rounding tolerance are normalized and scored; vectors outside rounding tolerance are invalid and incorrect.

openjev.timing: Loopback HTTP full-response wall time including validation; model loading outside timer.

hosted.timing: Full HTTPS request wall time including response validation.
hosted.gpt_output: Verbalized probabilities in constrained JSON, not token logprobs.

protocol.latency_limit: Heterogeneous quality-run diagnostics with one observation per task. No repeated latency benchmark, matched hardware, throughput, or energy-efficiency claim.
protocol.cost_limit: Hosted usage-times-tariff estimates are not billing receipts. Local compute is unmetered, not free.
protocol.probability_limit: Native and verbalized probability metrics do not measure equivalent intrinsic model confidence.

next_stage.description: A new 27B training iteration with more diverse training data is being prepared.
next_stage.note: The results above use the already released 2B/9B baselines and hosted models.

notes: This evaluates the already released 2B and 9B adapters and decision heads; these are not newly trained checkpoints.
The 231-task public subset is separate from the existing 76-case provider comparison and release-v2 test/OOD evaluation.
No raw task text, states, labels, task IDs, provider responses, credentials, or absolute node paths are exported.
